resources.string: Instantaneous flow through a heart valve

This idealized example shows forward blood flow through the selected valve at one instant. Speed is averaged across the opening. The inputs and results are for demonstration only, not personal measurements or reference values.
Q = A × v; cm² × cm/s = cm³/s = mL/s.
If flow stays steady for 0.1 s, %1$s mL of blood would pass through the valve.
